yaru-icon-theme.install:
%meson_install
# Could not get false flags and -Daccent-colors to work properly.
# it would only install Yaru-icons without the accent colors.
# Remove the files instead.
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/themes"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/sounds"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/gnome-shell"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/gtksourceview-4"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/gtksourceview-5"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/glib-2.0"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/xsessions"
rm -rf "%(installroot)/usr/share/wayland-sessions"

yazi.install:
%cargo_install yazi ya

# generate shell completions
%install_file yazi-boot/completions/yazi.bash %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/yazi
%install_file yazi-cli/completions/ya.bash %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/ya

%install_file yazi-boot/completions/yazi.fish %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/yazi.fish
%install_file yazi-cli/completions/ya.fish %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/ya.fish

%install_file yazi-boot/completions/_yazi %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_yazi
%install_file yazi-cli/completions/_ya %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_ya

%install_file assets/logo.png %(installroot)%(datadir)/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/yazi.png
%install_file assets/yazi.desktop -t %(installroot)%(datadir)/applications/
yazi.environment:
export VERGEN_GIT_SHA="aerynOS"
export YAZI_GEN_COMPLETIONS=true
export RUSTONIG_SYSTEM_LIBONIG=1

youki.build:
%cargo_build

mkdir build
for shell in bash fish zsh; do
    ./%(cargo_target_dir)/youki completion --shell "$shell" > "build/$shell-completion"
done

yq.setup:
# goccy/go-json error text differs from encoding/json
%patch %(pkgdir)/goccy-go-json-error-message.patch
%go_mod
yq.install:
%install_bin yq

./yq shell-completion bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/yq
./yq shell-completion zsh | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_yq
./yq shell-completion fish | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/yq.fish
yq.check:
# ACL xattrs are unavailable in the boulder build environment (EINVAL)
go test -skip TestMultiPrinterWriterPreservesRestrictiveAccessACL ./...

yubico-authenticator.build:
pushd helper
%pyproject_build
popd

# Then, build the Flutter GUI
flutter pub get
flutter build linux --release
yubico-authenticator.install:
_yubico_authenticator_root=%(libdir)/yubico-authenticator
_yubico_authenticator_install=%(installroot)/$_yubico_authenticator_root

pushd helper
%pyproject_install
popd

%install_exe helper/authenticator-helper.py %(installroot)%(bindir)/authenticator-helper

%install_dir ${_yubico_authenticator_install}
cp -R build/linux/x64/release/bundle/* ${_yubico_authenticator_install}

%install_file ${_yubico_authenticator_install}/linux_support/com.yubico.yubioath.desktop %(installroot)/%(datadir)/applications/com.yubico.yubioath.desktop
%install_file ${_yubico_authenticator_install}/linux_support/com.yubico.yubioath.png %(installroot)/%(datadir)/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/com.yubico.yubioath.png

ln -srvf ${_yubico_authenticator_install}/authenticator %(installroot)%(bindir)/yubico-authenticator

rm -frv ${_yubico_authenticator_install}/linux_support

yubikey-manager.install:
%pyproject_install

%install_file %(workdir)/man/ykman.1 -t %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/

%install_file COPYING -t %(installroot)/usr/share/licenses/%(name)/

python_version=$(python -c 'import sys; print(".".join(map(str, sys.version_info[:2])))')
export PYTHONPATH=%(installroot)%(libdir)/python$python_version/site-packages
BIN=%(installroot)%(bindir)/ykman

_YKMAN_COMPLETE=bash_source $BIN | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/ykman
_YKMAN_COMPLETE=zsh_source  $BIN | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_ykman
_YKMAN_COMPLETE=fish_source $BIN | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/ykman.fish
